### Astrobiologiya

Groups: 3 · Skills: 12

[astrobiology.data.ts](../../../learningApps/astronomy/data/skills/astrobiology/astrobiology.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Scientific investigation of the possibility, conditions and evidence of life beyond Earth, including chemical origins, habitability and contamination risks. The methods of spacecraft observation are classified with astronomical instrumentation and evidence rather than presented as a separate astrobiological subject.

**User-friendly description (qm):** Yerden tışta yaşayışnıñ mümkün oluvı içün kerekli şartlarnı ve alimler onıñ işançlı delillerini nasıl tanıy bilgenini araştırıñız.

[astronomicalInstrumentsAndEvidence.data.ts](../../../learningApps/astronomy/data/skills/astronomicalInstrumentsAndEvidence/astronomicalInstrumentsAndEvidence.data.ts)

[celestialMechanics.data.ts](../../../learningApps/astronomy/data/skills/celestialMechanics/celestialMechanics.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** This domain concerns how gravity and angular momentum govern orbital motion, rotation and mutual perturbations across planetary and stellar systems. Geometrical appearances arising from these motions are addressed separately when the observational phenomenon itself is the competency.

**User-friendly description (qm):** Cazibe quveti ve areketniñ kâinattaki cisimlerniñ orbitalarını ve aylanmasını nasıl şekillendirgenini ögreniñiz.

**User-friendly description (qm):** Gelgit quvetleri ve başqa cazibe quveti tesirleşüvleriniñ kök cisimleriniñ areketini nasıl deñiştirgenini ögreniñiz.

### Kâinat cisimleri

Groups: 2 · Skills: 7

[cosmicObjects.data.ts](../../../learningApps/astronomy/data/skills/cosmicObjects/cosmicObjects.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** An overview of what kinds of physical objects and extended structures exist beyond Earth and how they are identified and organized. It teaches classification across cosmic scales and distinguishes an object's physical nature from its environment or apparent visual form; detailed physics belongs to the specialized planetary, stellar, galactic and cosmological domains.

**User-friendly description (qm):** Kâinatta bulunğan çeşit-çeşit cisimler ve quruluşlarnı, astronomlarnıñ olarnı nasıl sınıflaştırağanını ögreniñiz.

**User-friendly description (qm):** Astronomlarnıñ cisimlerni tek körünişlerine degil, fizikiy delillerine köre nasıl ayırğanını ögreniñiz.

**Methodological description (English):** Cosmology tests models for the Universe's large-scale composition, history and expansion using observations with known horizons and uncertainties. Unresolved questions must remain distinguishable from established evidence.

**User-friendly description (qm):** Astronomik deliller yardımınen Kâinatnıñ keñeyüvini, tarihını ve büyük miqyastaki quruluşını tetqiq etiñiz.

**User-friendly description (qm):** Kosmik ölçüvlerniñ alâ daa tam añlatıp olamağan terkibler ve sualler aqqında ne köstergenini ögreniñiz.
